Numerous other interns are below pay floor, unpaid, wrong discipline or expired; no inference that search counts equal relevant vacancies.

Current public examples were mostly below target: Integra Magna INR 3–5k/month, AMPM INR 10–15k/month, SDS INR 7–15k/month. Ungrammary cross-post adds an annual range and inactive-recruiter caveat to an existing role.
